newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices fall on low export demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices fall on low export demand.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery extended losses and fell from 1,178/1,179 rupees to 1,171/1,172 rupees on Friday on renewed speculative selling at higher levels, dealers said.
"Absence of fresh demand from the exporters and improved new crop arrivals triggered fresh bull liquidation," one dealer said.
Groundnut oil remained steady at the reduced level of 344/345 rupees per 10 kg on stray physical support and restricted arrivals of 60/70 tonnes against 100 tonnes reported on Thursday.
In Rajkot spot oil was steady at 525/530 rupees per 15 kg.
